Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in test_email_faz7.py covering (a) GET /api/email/providers returns 6 presets (gmail/outlook/yahoo/icloud/yandex/generic) with correct hosts/ports/modes; (b) GET /api/email/accounts empty [] for fresh user; (c) POST /api/email/accounts with fake outlook credentials returns 400 with Turkish detail 'Hesap eklendi ama bağlantı başarısız: IMAP giriş başarısız — e-posta veya app-password hatalı' AND rolls back the DB row (subsequent GET accounts is []); (d) invalid email 'notanemail' returns 400 with 'Geçerli bir e-posta adresi giriniz'; (e) DELETE nonexistent id returns {deleted:0}; (f) 401 without Bearer on /accounts and /accounts POST; (g) 402 NO_LICENSE for fresh user without a license on both GET and POST /accounts. Frontend: Playwright verified E-posta tab in sidebar (tab-email), empty state (email-empty with text 'Kayıtlı e-posta hesabın yok' + HESAP EKLE button [email-add-first]), Add form renders all fields (email-input, email-password-input, email-provider-select, email-add-submit), selecting 'Diğer (Özel)' (generic) reveals custom IMAP/SMTP host+port inputs, submitting fake creds shows sonner toast 'Hesap eklendi ama bağlantı başarısız: IMAP giriş başarısız — e-posta veya app-password hatalı' AND stays on form (no account_select appears — rollback confirmed on client side), İPTAL cancel returns to email-empty state, sidebar Reorder.Group intact (tab-tasks still clickable after all interactions).
critical_code_review_comments: email_router.py POST /accounts flow inserts the row FIRST via es.add_account then runs test_connection and deletes on failure. This means every failed add causes an insert+delete round-trip and could leak duplicate-key errors if a user retries quickly with the same email (add_account raises 400 'Bu e-posta hesabı zaten kayıtlı'). Consider moving test_connection BEFORE the insert (pass credentials directly to a temporary account dict) so the DB is only touched on success. Same design issue: if delete_account fails silently, the broken row lingers with a bad password_enc. Wrap the rollback in try/except with a logged error.

email_service._get_fernet() reads EMAIL_FERNET_KEY on every enc/dec call. Cache the Fernet instance at module import time (with lazy init) so we're not re-parsing the env var thousands of times during a bulk fetch.

email_service._list_messages_sync uses `mark_seen=False` — good — but the AND(seen=False, text=q) branch is a bug: imap-tools AND() combines with logical AND, however IMAP servers vary in support for 'TEXT' vs 'BODY' searches. Consider using AND(seen=False, body=q) or falling back to python-side filtering.

email_router.GET /providers has NO auth dependency — currently returns provider config publicly. This is intentional (frontend needs it before login is optional) but note it in the API docs. Low risk since values are static.

EmailPanel.jsx AddAccountForm has form.provider='auto' as a client-only value that is stripped from payload — server then infers provider from email domain. Works, but the toast message on success reads 'ekleme başarısız' if server 400s. Consider surfacing the provider-inference result back to the user for clarity.
EmailPanel.jsx uses window.confirm for delete confirmations — inconsistent with the rest of Sertex which uses a custom modal (e.g. task delete). Consider a shadcn AlertDialog for parity.
email_service.py at 429 lines is fine; email_router.py at 185 lines is fine — no file-size issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Faz 7 test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_email_faz7.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_email_faz7.py -v -o addopts=''` (no xdist because it creates & deletes users with the same admin token; parallel workers could race). The fake-creds test hits the real outlook.office365.com IMAP server which typically rejects within 1-2s; timeout budget is 45s. If IMAP servers are ever slow (>30s) the test may show flaky — bump the timeout in email_service._open_mailbox (currently 30s) if needed. EMAIL_FERNET_KEY must be present in backend/.env or all email endpoints will 500. To test IMAP/SMTP with a REAL account, use a throw-away Gmail app-password and edit the fixture — but do NOT commit real creds.
